findings.reason: The contract exempts signature-verified logout notifications from endpoint rate limiting. Rejected notifications are limited to 120 per minute.
Verifies the signed logout notification and restricts revocation to matched sessions.
Uses the current browser session, checks CSRF, and requires fresh reauthentication for deletion.
Starts browser-bound login without reading or modifying an application record.
Consumes browser-bound state once and verifies ID token claims before binding identity.
Validates the Identity Sync service identity and issuer before provisioning.
Validates the Identity Sync service identity and issuer before membership removal.
Validates the Identity Sync service identity and issuer before anonymization.
Validates the Identity Sync service identity and issuer before identity inventory.
Requires the System Manager role before touching internal session mappings.
Deletes only session mappings selected by the verified logout notification.
System Manager maintenance deletes expired internal session mappings.
Internal callers save only the linked account or the site selected during authorized anonymization.
Authorized anonymization selects files owned by or attached to its linked account.
Authorized anonymization selects SSH keys belonging to its linked account.
Checks that the current non-guest user owns the identity link before writing the session mapping.
Only the verified login callback and authorized service provisioning create identity links.
Verified login and service provisioning create a team under its validated local owner.
Matches the current account and exact logout session ID before deleting the internal mapping.
